Khao — an iOS app (2026).

The problem was never a shortage of recipes. It was too many. Khao shows one dish at a time: swipe if it is wrong, cook it if it is right.

Diet is treated as a rule, never a preference — Jain, vegan, vegetarian, egg, allergies and fasting days are checked before anything is suggested, for everyone in the household.

Designed, written and built single-handed. Product design & engineering — Anirudh Kapoor. A·81.
